question: Does changing the source training objective on an identical K16 head improve the probability of selecting one box that passes Acc@25?
primary: Six directions equally weighted, strict oriented IoU > 0.25, 18620 ordinary Validation direction records (9310 target descriptions). Arithmetic mean across the three paired training seeds. Report individual seeds as repeated training runs, not an ensemble.
secondary: Acc@50, mean IoU, threshold rescues/harms versus frozen same-slate joint and v1, selection rate among records with a passing K16 candidate, source recording holdout, positive-count strata. Keep zero-positive and all other records for every evaluation.
fixed: R180 slate and existing PCA, R183 ordinary roster and per-record sample seed, original subject head 299 -> 48 -> 1 with GELU and dropout 0.1, identical initial linear residual of zero. All arms use frozen joint score plus residual for fit, source checkpoint selection and target prediction. Maintained incumbent tie policy. No new box, no target update, no access to FINAL.
objectives: R182 generic original multi-positive mass25 + 0.5 mass50 + 0.5 row-mean equal-weight RankNet
sum of negative log-softmax over positives, then mean over fit records
C divided by each record's positive count
independent sigmoid BCE, mean over 16 candidates and training records, no class weights
source_fit: Reuse R182 640 ordinary source examples per platform, fit only original rows with at least one IoU>0.25. The existing source-recording-disjoint calibration split of 160/64/160 (Waymo/Drone/Quad) is used in full. Equal epoch budget, AdamW 0.001 and weight decay 0.002, batch 32, 20 epochs, source checkpoints 5/10/15/20 ordered by Acc25, Acc50, mIoU, earlier epoch. All five arms share the same initial state, batch permutation and dropout seed stream in each replicate.
seeds: Per-source R182 seed 182361 + source index in archived PLATFORMS plus the three fixed offsets [0,1000,2000]. No selection across seeds.
dummy: On all source-fit eligible rows, hold frozen joint logits fixed, append 0/16/48 constant -1000 logits with zero IoU; measure float64 gradient on the original K16. Compare per-row scaling, orientation, and strata of real positive count. Replay the 3D box counterexample and compare dummy-only expansion for the isolated pair objective versus the complete objective.
baselines: archived R183 generic joint ranker, original trained-independent/evaluated-joint, single matched original seed for readout-alignment diagnosis
uncertainty: Paired by target recording, same resampling weights for its two directions. 2000 resamples, seed 4171. Compute seed-average per direction per record, paired against matching seeds; report three individual seed estimates separately. Counts per seed or mean over seeds; no pseudo-replication.
decision: Evaluate C against B, A, D, E and frozen. Distinguish an absolute localization gain from improvement relative only to a lossy trained arm. Mechanism alone or target-score selection does not establish successful cross-platform repair. No target-led changes, architecture selection, target threshold tuning, or new evaluation inputs.
